description: Profile a creator from a link: their latest 12 videos with views, likes, comments, shares, length, posting date and caption (cut at 300 characters), the median views of those videos and each video's x_median (views over the median); videos at 2× the median or more are flagged top. The author: handle, name, profile link and followers; cadence is videos a week. Pass source_url: an Instagram profile or reel link (instagram.com/<handle>, instagram.com/reel/<code>, /p/<code>) or a TikTok profile or video link (tiktok.com/@<handle>, tiktok.com/@<handle>/video/<id>, vm.tiktok.com/<code>); a video link profiles its author. YouTube is refused. A number the platform did not give is null, never 0, and named in warnings; numbers are as of measured_at. 20 credits, held at the start and charged once it succeeds; a private or empty account, or any failure, costs nothing. 30 new profiles per hour per account. Within an hour the same link, or any handle link of a creator already profiled (a reel's author included), answers the same profile, free. Usually done in about 20 seconds: the answer waits for it, and an unfinished one names get_creator_profile with wait_seconds: 50 in poll. display_markdown is a ready table to show as is, per display_hint; untrusted_content lists the third-party text fields. Price: 20 credits per call. Quote first with quote_creator_profile; list_prices names every price.
name: analyze_creator
title: Profile a creator
